decision.explanation: Document D1 explicitly states Erik Furuhjelm received the 'Pro Finlandia Medal' (D1S2, D1S10, D1S11). Document D2 describes a fictional scenario where he receives the 'Lakatos Award' (D2S1, D2S7). Per instructions to preserve distinct valid referents and avoid equating competing assertions, both awards are included as they appear in the provided source text as claims regarding the same entity.
